children.text:
Built a multi-tenant SaaS platform for multi-location businesses with Google OAuth, onboarding, and per-business role-based access control.

Collaboration made easy by sharing a portal and records to be populated into a website. A developer worries about the code while the business owner worries about what content gets displayed. Using API...

CHANGE ME

– Developed core features for a syllabus builder web application used by instructors to create and manage course syllabi
– Constructed dynamic tab-based workflows and content management features using HTMX partial updates and Django
templates based on MVP requirements
– Designed reusable responsive UI components with TailwindCSS and DaisyUI across multiple modules
– Led frontend development, shaped UI/UX decisions, and provided design feedback and technical guidance to teammates
– Collaborated within a 7-person Agile team using GitHub, Jira, code reviews, and sprint-based development practices
Videogame Dashboard (Vite, NodeJS, ExpressJS, REST APIs, Vercel, Render, Vitest) Nov 2025 – Dec 20

– Developed a full-stack analytics dashboard integrating Steam and IGDB APIs to visualize the videogame industry market
– Built interactive data visualizations, filtering systems, and responsive React components using ChartJS
– Built ExpressJS backend endpoints to fetch and deliver videogame data to the React frontend
– Deployed frontend and backend services using Vercel and Render with automated cloud-based hosting workflows
– Implemented automated testing with Vitest to validate API response processing and application functionality

-  Built and launched the restaurant's website with React and Vite, deployed on AWS S3 and CloudFront
- Gathered requirements from the owners and turned them into features, iterating on feedback through
launch
